_doc: Bootstrap case library. A case is a starting condition the system must boot from. `when` is an all-of match on facts (see `defaults` for every fact and its conservative default when unknown). `routes` are tried in order, each reversible and each with a probe; the case ends in at most ONE owner card, and only when every route is exhausted by an identity-bound step. Cards with the same id are merged across cases. Read by bootstrap/cases.py; every case is documented in docs/BOOTSTRAP-GAPS.md.

routes.step: Apply as an individual where the programme allows it (open-source funders, research grants); mark entity-only programmes as deferred in the registry with the reason
routes.probe: every deferred packet names the missing prerequisite

routes.step: Keep packets drafted so they ship the day an entity exists
routes.probe: funding_packet.py reports drafted, none stale

owner_card.what: Choose and register the owning entity and assign the IP to it
owner_card.why: a legal act with the owner's identity and money
owner_card.default: projects run in the owner's own name; entity-only programmes stay deferred
owner_card.probe: entity name set in LICENSE and applicant.json

cases.title: No domain e-mail address for the project

routes.step: Add an e-mail forwarding alias at the domain's DNS or registrar through the platform API (reversible; nothing is bought)
routes.probe: a test message to the alias reaches the owner's inbox

routes.step: Use the alias as the reply route in packets only after the probe passes
routes.probe: packet reply route equals the alias

cases.title: No accounts exist (social, funder portals, registries)

routes.step: Draft every post and application, run the guards, keep them queued in dry-run
routes.probe: social and outreach dry-run logs show queued items

routes.step: Use channels that need no account first: the repo, the open-source registry listings that accept a pull request, public mailing lists with a published route
routes.probe: at least one no-account route is queued

owner_card.what: Sign in to the listed services on the system's own connect page
owner_card.why: creating an account in the owner's name is an identity-bound act
owner_card.default: posting and portal submissions stay dry-run
owner_card.probe: the first run logs posted or sent

routes.step: Probe every surface in order and record what each returned: the device session's own login and scopes, the platform connector, the Actions token, a GitHub App manifest
routes.probe: boot-log surfaces section lists each route as ok or blocked with reason

routes.step: Treat an admin:org scope found on any surface as the org-admin credential
routes.probe: org-manage probe succeeds

routes.step: Work in the one repository that accepts writes until a credential exists
routes.probe: monorepo is canonical in docs/BOOTSTRAP-GAPS.md

owner_card.what: Allow the system to set up its GitHub organization
owner_card.why: approving access to the owner's organization is identity-bound
owner_card.default: holding page only; profile content staged in the repo

cases.title: No sender identity for outreach e-mail

routes.step: Run outreach in dry-run: queue and guard everything; form-route targets go into one consolidated card per profile
routes.probe: outreach/STATUS.md lists queued and awaiting-owner targets

routes.step: Never send from the owner's personal mailbox
routes.probe: gate.json sender.registered stays false until the card closes

owner_card.what: Connect one mailbox for outreach on the system's own connect page
owner_card.why: creating a sending identity is the owner's act
owner_card.probe: a run logs sent for an e-mail-route target

cases.title: Research programme with no institution behind it

routes.step: Read each research funder's eligibility at the source and mark individual-eligible, institution-required and unknown
routes.probe: registry rows carry the eligibility note

routes.step: For institution-required programmes, draft a host-institution inquiry through the same outreach pipeline (published contact routes only)
routes.probe: a host-inquiry packet exists

routes.step: Pick the smallest model tier and free runtime tiers; log cost per tick
routes.probe: boot report shows the small tier

routes.step: Put funding at the top of the backlog: registry, packets, outreach
routes.probe: funding items are the highest priority open items

cases.title: The agent session cannot reach funder or office websites

routes.step: Mark every unread registry row unverified; never contact from an unverified row
routes.probe: outreach shows blocked-by source-unverified

routes.step: Verify from the scheduled CI runner, which has open network, and promote rows by reviewed PR
routes.probe: funding-maintenance run reports the row read

cases.title: A repository is archived, private or unwritable

routes.step: Work in the canonical repository and record the other as a mirror target
routes.probe: mirror target listed in docs/BOOTSTRAP-GAPS.md

routes.step: Unarchive or mirror through the admin credential when it exists
routes.probe: gh repo view shows isArchived false

cases.title: The owner's computer is not reachable (server-side only: no step may depend on it)

routes.step: Run everything through scheduled workflows and the platform connectors; no step depends on the owner's device
routes.probe: boot-log surfaces shows a workflow route ok

routes.step: Queue cards with defaults in effect; they wait without blocking other work
routes.probe: dashboard shows each card with its default
